traits.note: Farjon (2017), Larix (printed pp. 497-498, 507-511): Rauh's model, branches spaced regularly up a monopodial trunk; deciduous needles spiral and remote on long shoots and in dense tufts on short shoots; seed cones single at short-shoot tips, more or less erect, even on hanging branches. Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, p. 60), Larix: leaves "spirally arranged and remote on leading shoots, densely crowded on the lateral spur-like twigs"; its key to the family (p. 51) puts Larix under "Cones maturing the first year".
